_comment: Its paraphrase stage runs humanizer-12b and its attacks translate on translategemma-27b, both local vLLM models (a GPU). To serve gen and check there too, name venice-uncensored-fp8 for gen; paraphrase_check stays on the hosted default unless it names that model too. Without a GPU, take paraphrase out of stages, and set "translation": false in augmentations.adversarial or name the hosted deepseek-v3.2 for translation.
